Prevent defects, security issues, and policy violations by catching problems at commit time through linting, formatting, type checking, unit tests, security scans, and commit message vali...

skills.long_description: Implement features using the Test-Driven Development workflow: write tests first, then write code to make them pass. This Anthropic-favorite approach ensures high code quality, comprehensive test coverage, and fewer bugs.

skills.name: trend-research
skills.title: trend-research
skills.description: Research recent trends (last 30 days) on any topic and generate production-ready prompts
skills.long_description: Research any topic across Reddit, X (Twitter), and the web to identify recent trends (last 30 days), synthesize community consensus, and generate production-ready prompts or recommendations based on real-world usage patterns.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: context-manager
skills.title: context-manager
skills.description: Manage and maintain context across large codebases. Covers context fundamentals (attention budget, progressive disclosure, compaction triggers) and practical techniques for navigating and synthesizing information.
skills.long_description: Manage information and maintain context across large codebases, ensuring consistent understanding when working on changes spanning multiple files. Includes foundational context engineering concepts: 5-component context model, attention budget management, progressive disclosure, and 70-80% compaction triggers.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: task-coordinator
skills.title: task-coordinator
skills.description: Coordinate complex multi-step tasks with dependency tracking. Covers multi-agent architectural patterns (supervisor, swarm, hierarchical), token economics, and handoff protocols.
skills.long_description: Break down complex development tasks into manageable subtasks, coordinate parallel execution, manage dependencies, and ensure comprehensive completion. Includes multi-agent coordination patterns (supervisor/orchestrator, peer-to-peer/swarm, hierarchical), token multiplier economics, and structured agent handoff protocols.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: context-degradation
skills.title: context-degradation
skills.description: Detect and mitigate context quality decay in long AI agent sessions. Covers 5 degradation patterns, severity assessment, and the 4-bucket mitigation approach.
skills.long_description: Recognize, diagnose, and recover from context quality degradation in AI-assisted development sessions. Covers 5 degradation patterns (Lost-in-Middle, Context Poisoning, Context Distraction, Context Confusion, Context Clash), severity assessment with diagnostic probes, 4-bucket mitigation (writing, selecting, compressing, isolating), and recovery verification.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: context-compression
skills.title: context-compression
skills.description: Minimize tokens per task in long-running agent sessions while preserving critical information. Covers anchored summarization, observation masking, and session handoff procedures.
skills.long_description: Compress conversation context to extend effective session length and maintain quality. Covers 3 compression approaches (Anchored Iterative Summarization, Observation Masking, Regenerative Full Summary), compression need assessment, structured summary templates, session handoff documents, and probe-based quality validation.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: tool-design
skills.title: tool-design
skills.description: Design effective tools and APIs for AI agent consumption (MCP servers, slash commands, function schemas). Covers LLM-oriented design, description engineering, and error recovery patterns.
skills.long_description: Design tools, APIs, and function interfaces that AI agents can use effectively. Covers the consolidation principle, 4-part description engineering framework, 10-20 tool limit management, error messages for agent recovery, naming conventions, and testing against actual agent interactions. Applicable to MCP servers, Claude Code slash commands, and general function-calling interfaces.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: filesystem-context-patterns
skills.title: filesystem-context-patterns
skills.description: Use the filesystem as a first-class context management tool for AI agent sessions. Covers scratch pads, plan persistence, sub-agent communication, dynamic skill loading, and self-modification patterns.
skills.long_description: Use the filesystem to extend, persist, and share agent context beyond the conversation window. Covers 6 patterns: scratch pad (offload large outputs), plan persistence (survive context resets), sub-agent communication (file-based message passing), dynamic skill loading (on-demand skill loading), terminal persistence (capture command output), and self-modification (agents updating their own instructions).
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: ai-output-evaluation
skills.title: ai-output-evaluation
skills.description: Evaluate AI-generated output quality using LLM-as-judge techniques, multi-dimensional rubrics, and bias mitigation. Use when building quality gates for AI-powered pipelines.
skills.long_description: Systematically evaluate the quality of AI-generated output using structured rubrics, LLM-as-judge patterns, and bias mitigation techniques. Covers multi-dimensional rubric design, direct scoring with evidence requirements, end-state evaluation principles, top 3 bias mitigations (verbosity, position, self-enhancement), and token economics for evaluation pipelines.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: writing-editing
skills.title: writing-editing
skills.description: Professional writing and editing principles for clear, concise documentation and prose. Use when asked to write, edit, rewrite, or review documents, README files, reports, blog posts, or any non-code text content.
skills.long_description: Applies professional editor and technical writer standards to all written output. Covers clarity, concision, structure, active voice, logical hierarchy, and smooth transitions. Includes refinement guidance for rewrites.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: analysis-logic
skills.title: analysis-logic
skills.description: Structured analytical reasoning and data presentation principles. Use when asked to analyze data, compare options, evaluate trade-offs, create decision matrices, or present findings with tables and structured reasoning.
skills.long_description: Applies data analyst and strategist standards to analytical tasks. Covers step-by-step reasoning, assumption identification, BLUF summaries, table-based comparisons, and critical thinking with edge case consideration.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: creative-generation
skills.title: creative-generation
skills.description: Creative direction for image prompts, presentation slides, and ideation. Use when asked to generate image prompts, design slide decks, brainstorm ideas, create visual concepts, or produce creative content.
skills.long_description: Applies creative director standards to generative and design tasks. Covers detailed image generation prompts, presentation slide design with speaker notes, and structured ideation with varied, distinct options.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: check-usage
skills.title: check-usage
skills.description: Check Claude Code usage limits and get smart model-switching recommendations based on current consumption. Auto-fetches from the Anthropic API.
skills.long_description: Analyze current Claude Code usage limits (session, weekly all-models, weekly Sonnet-only) and provide actionable recommendations for model selection, usage optimization, and cost-effective task planning. Auto-fetches usage data from the Anthropic OAuth API via curl (falls back to manual entry if credentials are unavailable). Complements the usage-display Stop hook (passive CLI monitoring) and the VS Code extension (visual monitoring).
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: generate-changelog
skills.title: generate-changelog
skills.description: Generate a complete CHANGELOG.md from git history, tags, and commit messages following the Keep a Changelog format.
skills.long_description: Generate a comprehensive CHANGELOG.md by analyzing the full git history, version tags, and commit messages. Categorizes changes using conventional commit parsing and keyword inference into Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed, Deprecated, and Security sections. On first run, reconstructs the entire changelog from all tagged releases. On subsequent runs, offers to regenerate or update only the [Unreleased] section. Includes GitHub comparison links in the footer.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe

skills.name: generate-report
skills.title: generate-report
skills.description: Generate a professional Word (.docx) or PowerPoint (.pptx) report from one or more Markdown files, preserving template branding and generating editable diagram shapes.
skills.long_description: Convert Markdown analysis files into polished Word documents or PowerPoint presentations. Preserves branded templates (title page images, logos, margins, headers, footers). Synthesizes content from multiple files into a single deduplicated report with proper heading hierarchy. Generates a companion PPTX with editable PowerPoint shapes (rectangles, connectors) for each diagram. Supports table rendering, Mermaid figure placeholders, and horizontal rule handling.
skills.author: Benjamin Dourthe
